title: 第3章 吃软饭第4章 灵魄丹
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
苏铭只觉头皮一阵发麻。
林念瑶那直勾勾的眼神，好似要将他看穿。
这丫头，莫不是又想对自己无礼？
“你……你这眼神啥意思？”苏铭眉头微皱，开口问道，心中却暗自腹诽，上次被这丫头弄得灰头土脸，这次可不能再栽了。
林念瑶嘴角轻扬，露出一抹勾人的笑，那姿态，仿若九天仙女下凡，美得让人移不开眼。
“怎么，怕本姑娘了？”她莲步轻移，身姿摇曳，靠近苏铭，那股子香风都让苏铭有些恍惚。
苏铭心中一紧，脸上却摆出一副强硬模样：“怕？我苏铭可不知道这字咋写！”
“我还得进万宝楼买东西，没空跟你在这儿瞎扯。”说完苏铭就朝着万宝楼内走去。
可实际上，苏铭心里慌得一批，上次的经历还历历在目，这丫头的行事风格，他实在捉摸不透。
目前自己刚能修炼，又打不过这林念瑶，真怕这丫头干点别的事情出来，还有比昨天那事儿更离谱的吗？
“哼，嘴硬！”林念瑶美目流转，那眼神像是在说，苏铭这点小心思，她一眼便看穿了。
苏铭咬咬牙，心中暗自发誓：“此仇不报非君子，我定要找回属于男人的尊严！下次，哼哼，定要让你尝尝被无礼对待的滋味！”
苏铭踏入万宝楼，心中暗自嘀咕：“此番前来，定要购置药材与炼丹炉，可千万别出啥岔子。”
“哟，这不是苏大少嘛！”
店小二满脸堆笑，迎了上来，“咱万宝楼的药材，那可都是天材地宝级别的。像这千年灵参，固本培元，功效逆天，只要三万两金子，或者三百块灵石，苏大少要不要来一株？”
苏铭瞧了瞧那灵参，眼中闪过一丝渴望，是自己所需要的！可转瞬又黯淡下去，暗自想着：“这价格，简直离谱，我这囊中羞涩，哪能掏出这么多钱。”
“还有这炼丹炉，乃是玄铁所铸的炎阳炉，炼制丹药事半功倍，只需五万两金子，或者五百块灵石，苏大少，这可不容错过啊！”店小二继续卖力推销。
苏铭皱了皱眉，心中盘算着：“这般昂贵，我实在难以承受，看来只能退而求其次了。”
“小二，可有便宜些的炼丹炉？”苏铭开口问道。
“有有有，苏大少，这边请。这地火炉，虽比不上炎阳炉那般神妙，可也是炼制丹药的好帮手，价格实惠，只需一万两金子，或者一百块灵石。”店小二连忙介绍道。

苏铭咬了咬牙，心想：“罢了罢了，先买下这地火炉，至于药材，再想其他法子。”
“就它了，给我包起来。”苏铭下定决心说道。
付完钱，苏铭捧着那地火炉，心中满是无奈：“如今有了炼丹炉，却没了药材，这可如何是好？”
“苏大少，不再看看药材啦？咱这还有不少珍稀品种呢。”店小二仍不死心。
“不必了，下次再说。”苏铭摆了摆手，转身离去，心中却在思索着寻药材的办法。
正在这时。
林念瑶莲步轻移，身姿婀娜地走了过来。
content_en:
Su Ming felt his scalp numb.
Lin Nianyao's piercing eyes seemed to want to see through him.
Is this girl trying to be rude to me again?
"You...what do you mean by that look in your eyes?" Su Ming frowned slightly and asked, but secretly cursed in his heart. He was made disgraced by this girl last time, but he can't let it happen again this time.
The corners of Lin Nianyao's mouth raised slightly, revealing a seductive smile. Her posture was like a fairy from the Nine Heavens descending to earth, so beautiful that people couldn't take their eyes away.
"Why, are you afraid of me?" She moved lightly, swaying, and approached Su Ming. The fragrant wind made Su Ming feel a little dazed.
Su Ming's heart tightened, but he put on a tough look on his face: "Afraid? I, Su Ming, don't know how to write this word!"
"I have to go into Wanbao Building to buy something. I don't have time to talk nonsense with you here." After saying this, Su Ming walked towards Wanbao Building.
But in fact, Su Ming was panicking. The last experience was still vivid in his mind. He couldn't figure out this girl's behavior.
At present, I have just been able to practice, but I can't beat Lin Nianyao. I am really afraid that this girl will do something else. Is there anything more outrageous than what happened yesterday?
"Hmph, you're so tough!" Lin Nianyao's beautiful eyes seemed to be saying, she could see through Su Ming's little thoughts at a glance.
Su Ming gritted his teeth and swore secretly in his heart: "It is not a gentleman to take revenge. I will definitely regain the dignity that belongs to men! Next time, hum, I will let you taste the feeling of being treated rudely!"
Su Ming stepped into the Wanbao Tower and muttered to himself: "When I come here this time, I must buy medicinal materials and an alchemy furnace, but don't make any mistakes."
"Hey, isn't this Young Master Su!"
The waiter came up with a smile on his face, "The medicinal materials in our Wanbao Tower are all heavenly and earthly treasures. Like this thousand-year-old spiritual ginseng, which can strengthen the root and cultivate the body, and has unparalleled effects. It only costs 30,000 taels of gold or 300 spiritual stones. Do you want one, Mr. Su?"
Su Ming looked at the spiritual ginseng, a trace of desire flashed in his eyes, it was what he needed! But it dimmed again in an instant, and I thought to myself: "This price is simply outrageous. I am so short of money, how can I afford so much money?"
"And this alchemy furnace is a Yanyang furnace made of black iron. Refining elixirs is twice the result with half the effort. It only requires fifty thousand taels of gold, or five hundred spiritual stones. Young Master Su, you can't miss this!" The waiter continued to sell it hard.
Su Ming frowned and thought in his mind: "It's so expensive that I can't bear it. It seems I can only settle for the next best thing."
"Boy, is there a cheaper alchemy furnace?" Su Ming asked.
"Yes, yes, Young Master Su, please come here. Although this furnace is not as magical as the Yanyang furnace, it is also a good helper for refining elixirs. The price is affordable, only ten thousand taels of gold, or one hundred spiritual stones." The waiter in the store quickly introduced.
Su Ming gritted his teeth and thought: "That's all, buy this stove first, and then think of other ways to use the medicinal materials."
"That's it, wrap it up for me." Su Ming said with determination.
After paying the money, Su Ming held the stove and felt helpless: "Now that we have an alchemy furnace, but no medicinal materials, what should we do?"
"Young Master Su, don't you want to look at the medicinal materials anymore? We still have many rare varieties." The waiter still didn't give up.
"No need, we'll talk about it next time." Su Ming waved his hand, turned and left, but he was thinking about ways to find medicinal materials.
At this moment.
Lin Nianyao moved her steps lightly and walked over gracefully.
